texts: doha with a snake, about earning your bread honestly rather than by cheating
snake, honest earnings
My cousin got rich quickly by cheating customers, while I earn a modest living honestly, and last night a snake in the garden made me think of which of us sleeps better.
The snake gains by poison and stealth, the worker by sweat and truth, and only one eats his bread in peace.
Write a doha where a snake slips through the grass taking what it can, while an honest worker earns his bread by the sweat of his brow and eats it with a clear conscience.
At the spinning wheel she turns her honest yarn, and the touchstone of the world finds her earnings clean and true.
touchstone, spinning wheel, honest work
My grandmother earned our family's living at her spinning wheel for fifty years, and when the merchants checked her accounts there was never a single false stroke.
doha with a touchstone and a spinning wheel, about earning a clean living
Please write a doha where a woman at her spinning wheel earns the bread of her family by honest labour, and her earnings pass every test of the touchstone because no deceit has touched them.
A crow steals scraps from the courtyard while the working man earns his meal by labour; please write a doha that praises the dignity of bread earned honestly over bread taken by trickery.
doha with a crow, about earning your living honestly instead of stealing
The crow takes what it finds and caws in the dusk, but the worker's bread is sweet because it is his own.
crow, honest bread
A crow stole my lunch from the table, and I thought of how my father always said, better a dry crust you earned than a feast taken from another.
chakor bird, bee, honest work
doha with a chakor bird and a bee, about earning your own living
Write a doha where the bee gathers honey by honest labour from flower to flower, and the chakor bird only gazes at the sky, to praise the one who earns his bread by his own clean effort.
Our neighbour works like a bee at his small farm all day, earning his bread cleanly, while his brother sits like a chakor bird waiting for fortune to fall in his lap.
The bee works and the chakor bird waits, but the honey of honest labour sweetens only the one who toils.
doha about working in the sun for honest bread
Please write a doha about a farmer who labours in the sun from dawn to dusk, earning his meal with clean hands, and who sleeps soundly because no one has been cheated on his account.
Beneath the sun the worker bends, and the bread he earns is sweeter than a king's feast.
sun, sweat, clean earnings
My father came home every evening dark from the sun, tired but proud, and said that bread earned honestly has no bitterness in it.
The moneylender in our town got rich on other people's trouble, while my uncle earns his living by honest work with his hands and has never borrowed a paisa; I want a doha about the difference.
doha with a moneylender, about earning a clean living by your own work
Write a doha that contrasts the moneylender who grows rich on interest from the poor with the labourer who eats what his own hands have honestly earned, and finds peace in the plain meal.
moneylender, honest labour
The moneylender gathers gain from other men's sorrow, but the worker's bread is washed in his own clean sweat.
doha with a physician, about earning your living honestly by helping people
Our family physician charges only what is fair, never more, and he has been respected in our town for forty years; I'd like a doha for his kind of work.
physician, honest fees
The physician who takes only what is fair, and heals for the sake of healing, eats the sweetest bread of all.
Please write a doha about a physician who earns his living by honest service, taking only a fair wage for his work and never fleecing the sick, and who therefore lives with a clean conscience.
A blind man sells salt at the roadside, earning his small living by honest work, never cheating a customer, and I'd like a doha that honours his clean earnings over the riches of the cunning.
doha with salt and a blind man, about earning your bread honestly
salt, blind man, honest earning
Salt in the blind man's hand and truth in his heart, he earns his bread with clean palms and sleeps in peace.
The blind man who sells salt at our corner always gives exact change by touch, and I have never seen a more honest man.
I want a doha about a man who works at a modest job, never cheats, never takes a bribe, and comes home each evening with a clear conscience and a small earning that feeds his family nicely.
doha about earning your living honestly even if its small
My brother turned down an offer to take a bribe that would have doubled his income, and said he preferred to sleep soundly.
Bread honestly earned feeds both body and soul, while bread taken by cunning feeds only the body.
clean earnings
The leaf falls from the branch, the chakor bird gazes upward, and the honest worker keeps his eyes on his labour and eats what he earns.
Write a doha where a leaf falls and a chakor bird waits idly for a miracle, while a worker does his clean labour in the field, earns his bread honestly, and eats it in peace.
Every autumn I watch a single leaf come down while my neighbour, who works from dawn, ignores the sky and earns his bread, and I admire his steadiness.
doha with a leaf and a chakor bird, about earning your own bread
leaf, chakor bird, honest work
My father fished at dawn every day for forty years, brought home what he honestly caught, and never took more than he needed, while a chakor bird watched the night sky from the roof.
Write a doha about the fisherman who gets up at dawn, works honestly for his catch, and eats the fish he earned with a clear heart, while a chakor bird gazes at things beyond its reach.
doha with a chakor bird and a fish, about the dignity of earning your own food
The chakor looks for what it cannot have, the fisherman catches what he has earned, and his meal is sweet with honesty.
chakor bird, fish, honest labour
A parrot repeats clever words to win favours while gold falls into the hands of the cunning, but the labourer who earns his wage honestly eats bread sweeter than any such gold. Write a doha on this.
doha with a parrot and gold, about honest work being better than easy gains
parrot, gold, honest wages
My colleague talks like a parrot to the boss and gets promoted, while I do my honest work quietly and refuse to fiddle the numbers, and I want a doha that explains why I sleep better.
The parrot wins its seeds by flattery and the cunning win their gold by tricks, but the worker wins his bread by sweat.
doha about earning your living by honest hard work
My father always said that it is better to earn a little honestly than a lot by cheating, and he worked for forty years without once regretting that.
Honest sweat is the currency of a clear conscience, and no collector can take its peace.
bread of honest work

Please write a doha for a working person who takes pride in earning every rupee honestly, without bribes, tricks or shortcuts, and who finds that this plain living brings more satisfaction than any dishonest riches.
blind man, sandalwood, honest labour
doha with a blind man and sandalwood, about earning an honest living
The blind man sells sandalwood with a clean hand and a clean word, and his small earnings carry a fragrance that wealth cannot buy.
Write a doha about a blind man who sells sandalwood at the roadside, charging fairly and never cheating, whose honest earnings smell sweeter than the riches of those who get ahead by tricking others.
A blind man sells sandalwood paste near our shrine and has never once short-changed a customer, so everyone trusts him.
A potter works the clay with his own hands from dawn, earning his bread by honest sweat, while a snake sleeps beneath his wheel and cheats no one; please write a doha praising his clean livelihood.
The potter in our village shapes honest pots for honest prices, and the snake that lives in his wall has never stopped him from working, and he has never tried to cheat anyone.
The potter shapes the clay with clean hands, the snake keeps to its hole, and the bread of honest work is the sweetest in the land.
potter, snake, honest craft
doha with a potter and clay and a snake, about honest work
At the crossroads I met a grindstone seller who had turned down a dishonest sale, and I want a doha on the dignity of earning even a small living honestly.
doha with a crossroads and a grindstone, about earning your bread honestly
crossroads, grindstone, honest bread
At the crossroads, the honest worker chooses the grindstone's toil, for the road of cunning leads nowhere good.
Write a doha where a man stands at a crossroads, one road of quick gain by cheating and another of slow honest labour at the grindstone, and he chooses the latter and eats his bread in peace.
The physician and the priest in our village both earn their keep honestly, one by healing and one by serving, and I'd like a doha that honours such clean work.
physician, priest, honest service
doha with a physician and a priest, about earning a living cleanly

Please write a doha about a physician who heals for a fair fee and a priest who serves without greed, both earning their bread by honest work, in contrast to those who exploit people's fear and suffering.
The physician heals for a fair wage, the priest prays without a price, and both eat the bread of a clear conscience.
The bee gathers honey flower by flower, harming none, and takes only the sweetness that honest work allows.
bee, honest work
doha with a bee, about earning your own living cleanly
Write a doha about the bee that goes from flower to flower gathering its honey, never robbing the hive of another, and about the honest worker who earns his bread by the same clean toil.
Our beekeeper neighbour works from dawn to dusk, never cheats a buyer, and says honest honey tastes better; I'd love a doha on that.
doha with a skeleton, about earning your living honestly because you cant take it with you
My uncle cheated his way to a big business, and at his funeral I thought of how a skeleton carries no fortune, while my father's honest living leaves a name that people still respect.
skeleton, honest living

Please write a doha where a skeleton lies silent, bearing neither fortune nor guilt, and the honest worker beside it knows that bread earned cleanly leaves a good name behind, which is the only wealth that stays.
The skeleton keeps no ledger, but the name of the honest worker is remembered long after his bread is eaten.
My friend's parrot repeats everything, but he himself earns an honest living repairing watches and never cheats on a bill; I'd like a doha for him.
A parrot may mimic every trick of the cunning, but the honest worker earns his daily bread with his own two hands and eats it with a clear heart. Write a doha on the dignity of such clean earnings.
parrot, honest bread
doha with a parrot, about earning an honest living
The parrot chatters the cleverness of others while the honest worker quietly earns his own.
bell, honest wage
The bell rings at dawn calling workers to the field, and each earns his bread by honest sweat, none by trickery; please write a doha that honours the clean living of the labourer.
The bell calls the workers to the day's labour, and those who answer eat the bread that is truly theirs.
The factory bell rings at six, and my father has answered it for thirty years, earning every rupee with clean hands and never a complaint.
doha with a bell, about honest working people
doha with a palanquin and gold, about earning honestly instead of getting rich by cheating
The palanquin carries the cunning rich on the backs of others, while the honest worker walks home with gold that is clean.
The man who owns a palanquin-like luxury car got his gold by cheating the poor, while my father walks to work and earns an honest wage and sleeps soundly.
palanquin, gold, honest earning
Write a doha where a rich man rides in a palanquin on money got by cheating, while an honest labourer walks, earning a small amount of gold by sweat and enjoying a peace the rider cannot buy.
tree, honest sweat
A man plants a tree with his own hands and eats its fruit, and I'd like a doha that shows how bread earned by one's own honest labour is sweeter than any easy gain.
doha with a tree, about earning your own food by honest work
The tree grows from the planter's sweat, and the fruit tastes of honest labour and not of someone else's loss.
My grandfather planted every tree on our small farm himself, never cheating a neighbour of land or water, and left us a living that we are proud of.

A heron stands patiently in the shallows at dawn to earn its meal, while the lotus rises clean from the mud; write a doha about the honest worker who earns his bread patiently and stays pure in a muddy trade.
lotus, heron, clean earnings
The lotus rises from the mud untainted and the heron waits in the shallows for its meal, and the honest worker earns his bread like both.
My father worked in a rough trade for decades and stayed honest throughout, patient as a heron, clean as a lotus, and never took a rupee that wasn't his.
doha with a lotus and a heron, about earning your living honestly
The shroud has no pocket for dishonest gain, but the worker's honest name goes with him as his only coin.
At my grandfather's funeral I realised that all he left behind was a shroud and a name for honest dealing, and people spoke of it for an hour.

Write a doha where a man is wrapped in a shroud having taken nothing with him except a name for honest work, and those who cheated for gain find they must leave with empty hands and a stained reputation.
doha with a shroud, about earning an honest living and keeping a good name
shroud, honest name
My neighbour's son wanted to get rich quick through a shady business, but his father insisted he take an honest job first, and now he thanks him.
honest labour
doha about earning your own bread honestly
What is earned by the sweat of the brow is eaten without guilt, and what is taken by cunning is eaten with fear.
Please write a doha for a young person starting their working life, reminding them that a small honest earning is worth more than a large gain taken by cheating, because it brings peace to the table.
The mark on the brow and the milk in the cup are clean only if the earnings that bought them were clean.
The holy man with a bold mark on his forehead takes honest milk from the farmer who earned it with his own hands, and I want a doha about the farmer.
doha with a forehead mark and milk, about earning an honest living
forehead mark, milk, honest earning

Write a doha about a farmer who sells fresh milk without watering it down, earning his bread honestly, and who bears the mark on his forehead with pride because his living is as clean as his devotion.
A traveler stopped at our stall for jaggery and left us a fair price without haggling, and my mother said honest dealing always draws honest customers.
traveler, jaggery, honest trade
Write a doha about a man who makes jaggery with honest hands and sells it to travelers for a fair price, never cheating them, and whose modest earnings bring him more peace than a cheat's gains.
doha with a traveler and jaggery, about honest earnings
The traveler tastes the jaggery and pays a fair price, and the honest seller sleeps as sweetly as his wares.
bread of honest work
I took a small salaried job and refused extra cash under the table, and my wife says it is the best decision we have ever made.
doha about the dignity of earning your own living cleanly
Honest earnings are small but never run dry, while dishonest gains arrive in a rush and are gone.
Please write a doha about the quiet pride of the person who earns his living by honest work, never cheating, never begging, and who eats and sleeps with the ease that only clean earnings bring.
A woman spins thread at home, earning her family's bread by honest toil, selling at fair rates and cheating no one; please write a doha praising such clean and steady earning of a livelihood.
thread, honest earning
doha with thread, about earning an honest living by your own hands
Each thread she spins is spun in truth, and the cloth of her honest life is warm.
My grandmother sold her handspun thread at the weekly gathering for forty years and never once gave short measure, and she was loved for it.
honest sweat, clean bread
Bread earned by sweat is sweet to the taste, and bread taken by trick is bitter in the throat.
write a doha about earning your living the honest way
When I started my own business I decided never to bend the rules for a quick profit, and the first year was hard, but I sleep soundly.

Please write a doha about the worker who is proud to earn his living by honest labour, who neither cheats nor begs, and who finds in a simple meal the satisfaction of a day spent cleanly and truthfully.
The moth burns in borrowed light, while the worker earns his own and eats his bread without fear.
My cousin took a loan from shady people to get rich quick and was burned like a moth, while I stuck to my honest salary and slept in peace.
doha with a moth, about earning your bread honestly versus taking shortcuts
Write a doha where a moth rushes to the glow of easy gain and is burned, while the honest worker earns his bread by steady labour and enjoys its sweetness without any fear of loss.
moth, honest earnings
The touchstone tests the worth of metal, and the moon tests the heart at night; write a doha on how the honest worker's earnings pass both tests because they were earned cleanly and without deceit.
When the tax officer came to check my father's accounts, he passed every test like a touchstone, and that night my father sat under the moon and slept like a child.
doha with a touchstone and the moon, about earning an honest living
The touchstone finds the honest worker's earnings pure, and the moon shines on his peaceful sleep.
touchstone, moon, honest earnings
The honest worker sleeps with a quiet mind, for the bread on his table has no stain upon it.
I'd like a doha about the labourer who returns home at dusk with the day's honest wage, shares a simple meal with his family, and feels richer than any who have gained wealth through trickery.
My father came home every evening with a few notes and a smile, and we ate dal and rice and he always said it was the best meal of the day.
doha about the peace of earning your bread honestly
clean bread, quiet sleep
doha about working honestly for a modest wage

Please write a doha for a person who toils for modest pay but refuses every dishonest shortcut, and who finds that the self-respect and ease of mind he keeps are worth more than all the riches of those who cheat.
honest work, honest bread
He who eats the bread of his own labour eats the bread of dignity and goes to sleep without a debt.
I once refused to inflate an invoice for my boss, who offered me a bonus for it, and I have never regretted that choice.
doha with a pot of water and a bell, about earning your living honestly
Write a doha where a man carries a pot of water to sell in the morning to the sound of a bell, earns his small wage honestly, and eats his own bread without envy of the cunning rich.
A pot of water, a bell at dawn, and an honest wage: the worker asks for nothing more.
pot of water, bell, honest
The water seller in our town, who carries a pot of water from lane to lane at the sound of the bell, has never cheated anyone of a drop.
doha on earning your own bread cleanly
fair earning
I want a doha about the self-respect of someone who earns his living by his own labour, who never begs or steals, and who sits down to his meal with the calm of a person who owes nobody anything.
Since I started working as a plumber my dad no longer worries about me, because he knows that I make my living honestly.
Better a dry portion earned by the sweat of the brow than a banquet served on someone else's loss.
The traveler pays for his milk and goes his way, and the honest seller sleeps sweet, for his earnings are clean.
milk, traveler, honest trade
The old milkman on our road never waters his milk, and every traveler on the highway knows his stall, and he has never needed to advertise.
doha with milk and a traveler, about earning your bread honestly
Write a doha about a seller of fresh milk who treats every traveler fairly, never mixing in water, and who earns his daily bread honestly and cleanly, and so finds a peace that no cheat can buy.
honest bread
What the hands have earned in truth the heart can enjoy without fear.
Please write a doha for a person who earns his living by honest means, whose gains are small but never stained, and who sleeps and eats in peace because he owes his comfort to nobody's loss.
need a doha on clean honest earning
At the end of every month I check my pay slip and feel a quiet pride that every rupee of it was earned by honest work.
The prince in his palace eats rich food bought by taxes on the poor, while the honest labourer outside eats plain bread earned by his own sweat; please write a doha showing whose meal is sweeter.
doha with a palace, about earning your bread honestly vs getting rich by exploiting others
palace, honest bread
The palace feast is stained with other men's sweat, but the labourer's bread is clean and tastes of home.
My uncle works as a cleaner in a palace-like hotel, earns an honest wage, and goes home every night more content than the owners of the place.
The elephant labours to carry its master's load, and earns its keep by honest work, as does the man who eats only what he has earned.
We watched an elephant at the logging site working all day for its keep, and my grandfather said that an honest day of work is a gift, even for an elephant.
elephant, honest labour
Write a doha where a mighty elephant carries logs all day to earn its feed, and the worker beside it also earns his bread by honest sweat, both eating their meals without guilt or shame.
doha with an elephant, about the dignity of earning your own living
My neighbour sells vegetables from a cart, never uses false weights, and lives a calm life; I wish to write about him in a doha.
honest earnings
doha about the honest living of a small trader
Honest gain is a small thing that grows into a quiet peace, while dishonest gain grows into a restless fear.
Please write a doha about the quiet worth of earning a living honestly, without false weights or false words, so that even a small income carries respect, a clear mind and a good night's sleep.
doha with an inn and a bee, about earning an honest living
The bee gathers honey at the inn's garden and the keeper earns his fee with honest service, both eating the sweetness they have made.
Write a doha about an innkeeper who gives fair service to every guest at a fair price, never cheating them, and whose bees gather honey in the garden as he earns his living by honest work.
The keeper of the small inn near our village has never overcharged a guest, and his bees make honey in the garden that he sells at a fair price.
inn, bee, honest trade
Let me earn my bread with my own two hands and sleep without owing anything to any man.
doha about honest work and a clear conscience
Last winter I did overtime at the bakery to pay for my sister's books, and I came home tired but proud.
I would like a doha for the working man who gets up every morning to do an honest day's work, who takes no more than he has earned, and whose daily bread is a source of pride rather than shame.
clean earnings
The well gives water to all who draw honestly from it, and the worker draws his living from honest labour and is not afraid.
well, honest labour
In our village everyone takes water from the well in turn and no one cheats another, and I think that is how an honest living should be.
Write a doha where a well gives water to all fairly, and the person who draws his living from honest labour is like it: giving fair measure, taking fair wages, and leaving no one cheated.
doha with a well, about honest work
The cuckoo sings in the mango grove all spring and asks for nothing, and I try to live by that, earning only what my honest work brings; I'd love a doha on it.
cuckoo, honest earnings
doha with a cuckoo, about earning your own bread honestly
Write a doha where a cuckoo sings sweetly for its supper while the worker earns his bread by honest labour, both making a living from what they do best, and both free of deceit.
The cuckoo earns its meal with a sweet song, the worker with an honest day, and both sleep without fear.
Even though my tortoise-slow business makes less than others, I am proud that every rupee in it is clean, and I'd like a doha on slow, honest earning.
tortoise, honest earnings
Write a doha where a tortoise plods slowly towards its goal while the hare of quick gain falls asleep, and the honest worker earns his bread step by clean step and arrives in peace.
The tortoise goes slow but goes honest, and the bread it earns is eaten without fear or shame.
doha with a tortoise, about earning your living slowly but honestly
doha about earning your bread honestly and sleeping soundly
To eat what you have earned is to eat with a quiet heart, and no tax or robber can touch that peace.
My mom does piece work at home, never inflating a bill, and the neighbours say her word is as good as a signed contract.
clean earnings, clear mind
Please write a doha for the one who has chosen the honest path of a modest living over the quick path of a cheat, and who knows that the bread of honest work has a sweetness no trickery can match.
Under the date palm, my grandfather taught me that the tree gives fruit to the one who tends it, and that honest effort is the only sure way to earn your bread.
The date palm and the tree reward those who tend them, and honest labour bears fruit that no robber can steal.
doha with a date palm and a tree, about earning your living honestly
date palm, tree, honest labour
Write a doha where a man tends a date palm and another tree with patient hands, earning their fruit by honest labour, and eats his bread in peace, free of the guilt that comes with unearned gain.
doha about the pride of earning your bread by honest work
When I got my first pay slip I bought my mother a small gift with money I had earned honestly myself, and her eyes filled with pride; I want a doha to capture it.
honest bread, proud heart
Please write a doha about the sweet and quiet pride of eating bread earned by honest effort, a pride that no money from shortcuts can buy and no cunning can take from the worker.
The bread of honest hands is plain and sweet, and the sweetness is in the earning.
